posts.text: We’ve started rolling it out to trusted testers, with wider access coming soon. More info + the link to the Genie 4 waitlist in our blog, can't wait to see what you create with it! https://t.co/jh46gIRr2h

Very excited to share Genie 4, our incredible interactive world model, bringing together real-time physics, reasoning, and audio! Simulations within simulations, makes you wonder just how deep the rabbit hole goes... I have a feeling we will be finding out soon enough... https://t.co/NAAo2aTCey
